name: MotherDuck
description: Validate access to MotherDuck and the metadata visible to the configured token.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can properly reach the service and authenticate with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to MotherDuck. Validate the access token.

steps.name: GetDatabases
steps.description: List the MotherDuck databases visible to the token.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List all the schemas available to the user.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list all the schemas available to the user.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: List the tables belonging to a schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list the tables belonging to a schema.

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List the views belonging to a schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list the views belonging to a schema.
